units.function: Performance/truthfulness regression tests for Skill detail Agent-usage projection.
units.dependencyDirection: Embedded PostgreSQL and a tracked Drizzle proxy drive the large companySkillService while adapter runtime listing is replaced by a never-resolving mock.
units.keyDataModels: Company Skill key/slug/markdown/source metadata, Agent desiredSkills configuration and usedByAgents desired/actual state.
units.lifecycle: Seed local Skills/Agents; request detail under a one-second race; prove no adapter runtime probe and no implicit full Skill-row selection; clean temporary filesystem/database state.
units.testAssessment: The two tests encode valuable principles: do not block detail views on external runtime state, never claim unknown actual state, support key/slug compatibility and avoid loading unrelated large markdown. Both tests were explicitly skipped after embedded PostgreSQL failed to start; no passing claim. They omit tenancy/not-found, high Agent cardinality, lifecycle filtering, ambiguity, provenance/version/test/policy fields, secret redaction and responsibility/data authority.
units.designRationale: Keep the Skill detail page fast and available even when an Agent adapter hangs, and prevent large Skill content from inflating usage-resolution queries.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs fast, honest Connector capability/Skill detail projections whose desired, observed and attested states remain distinct.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the no-runtime-probe, null-unknown-state, explicit-column and hang-regression scenarios into Connector Capability detail tests. Add observed-at/attestation provenance, lifecycle, high-cardinality batching, tenant/data visibility and responsible-human certification cases.
units.responsibilityConflict: The projection only says an Agent desires a Skill; it does not identify who assigned/approved it, which policy/data scope applies, whether runtime attestation is current or who is accountable for use.
